additional_concerns: The candidate has no executable formalization. The LegalRuleML UNSUPPORTED result establishes no semantic preservation or legal conclusion.

Practical authority and supervisory conduct may inform effective retention, but the excerpts do not make either necessary or sufficient. Requiring reserved operational decisions, self-performance, or a universal reasonable-care safe harbour would add unsupported conditions.
Defective records do not alone establish surrendered accountability; retained accountability does not establish proper records or sound operations. Actual arrangements and conduct remain unprovided.

Paragraph 14 distinguishes confirmation from demonstration upon SFC request. Footnote 5 supplies minimum content without clearly resolving every attachment ambiguity. Absence of a request does not extinguish continuing responsibility or substantive duties.

The repeated UT Code 6.8 register provision permits an appointed register keeper while footnote 1 preserves Product Provider responsibility. The separate intermediary issuance provision likewise preserves responsibility despite outsourcing, but its actor and activity conditions cannot automatically be transferred to every Product Provider.

Part A of the Tokenised Securities Circular Appendix, footnote 2, and the remaining requirements referenced as paragraphs 10 to 13 are not fully supplied. Their absence limits broader compliance conclusions; no external dependency identifiers are supplied.
